listings.rawTitle: Eau des Sens Eau de Toilette Women 50 ml
listings.description: Attempting to capture all the facets of the bitter orange tree in a single fragrance is a bold endeavor. With its composition, the Eau de Toilette Eau des Sens creates a sense of wonder. It caresses the palate like a delicacy and invigorates with its freshness like a bubbling stream. A unique creation in which all facets of the bitter orange tree are expressed: branches, leaves, blossoms, and fruit.Notes: orange blossom, angelica root, patchouli, and juniper berries.

listings.rawTitle: Camées Parfumés Room Diffuser 1 piece
listings.description: The scented cameo will become liquid in approximately 10 minutes and will quickly begin to spread its perfume. You can use the cameo one time or several times. Simply extinguish the flame when desired.

listings.rawTitle: Oud´Ish Eau de Parfum Unisex 100 ml
listings.description: Oud is one of the most expensive raw materials used for perfume in the world. It has a uniquely special fragrance of sweet woods and woodland soils. listings.rawTitle: Pink Molecule 090.09 Eau de Parfum Unisex 100 ml
listings.description: The interpretation of the Nordic elements fused with pink champagne is the foundation of this perfume. The warm breeze that comes in the spring mixed with water and the dark trees in Denmark. A fragrance that has a grand opening of innocence and purity, but with strong sensual undertones - like „Sparkling-Molecule“. The fragrance is almost mineralic, in that it goes from the topnotes directly to the basenotes.Pink Molecule is a feminine perfume.

listings.rawTitle: The Muse Eau de Parfum Unisex 100 ml

listings.rawTitle: Roll on Perfume Oil Perfume Oil & Rollerballs Unisex 15 ml
listings.description: A perfume that can be worn by a woman or a man, like a white shirt that is shared, leaving a musky and woody scent on each one’s skin. The creamy notes of sandalwood paired with soft white musks bring a sensation of calm and ease, topped off with subtle ambery notes brought on by ambroxan, a renewable molecule. The delicate jojoba oil-based perfume makes applying it an intimate gesture. Close to the skin, a perfume for oneself, and for the ones who are close to us.Top Notes: AlmondHeart Notes: Freesia, seringat, Musc blancBase Notes: Santal essence Inde, Cèdre essence Himalya, Vetiver essence Haiti, note ambrée peau (Ambroxan)

listings.rawTitle: Nº3 Agua Fougere Cologne Eau de Cologne Unisex 125 ml
listings.description: South of Lisbon, the Troia peninsula boast beaches of golden sand backed by dunes planted with fragrant pine. Agua Fougère makes you travel to this forest by the sea with an unmistakable scent. This fragrance takes fougère to the next level, by adding a hint of jasmin in this tribute to Portugal’s windswept atlantic coast.Top Notes Pine needle, Galbanum, GeraniumHeart Notes Transparent jasmin, PepperBase Notes Sea moss, Cedar wood, Encens

listings.rawTitle: Parfum 1 Extrait de Parfum Unisex 50 ml
listings.description: Looking for an unapologetic scent that shifts any situation into top gear? Parfum 1 is not just powerful and mysterious, it’s a statement that only the real ones can fully understand. The fresh top notes of citrus and blackcurrant are infatuating and gracefully ride a wave of woody undertones like Sandalwood and Musk that trigger a craving like no other.“I knew it the second he walked by me for the first time. That scent would give me sleepless nights. His perfume was so mesmerizing that I probably couldn’t even tell you the color of his shirt, but I could talk about how that fragrance would make me feel for hours. So we did and lucky for me, those sleepless nights were not spent alone.” – Bram Niessink, FounderTop notes: Fresh Citrus, Blackcurrant, Spearmint, MandarinHeart notes: Davana, Oliban, Orangeblossom, Pink PeppersBase notes: Patchouli, Musks, Sandalwood, Cederwood

listings.rawTitle: Youth Eau de Parfum Unisex 100 ml
listings.description: With YOUTH, you leave the cool coast of Scandinavia behind you and travel to a unknown exotic place. A powdery, light homage to youth.Notes: Peach, light woods, white flowers and vanilla.

listings.rawTitle: Solid perfume Orphéon Perfume unisex 3 g
listings.description: A tribute to the evenings at the Diptyque founders' favorite 1960's jazz club, in a solid perfume to smooth onto wrists, neck or décolleté.Juniper and jasmine, swirling with smoke. Memories of midcentury evenings unfold in an infinitely refillable, alcohol-free balm applied with fingertips. A portable scented balm that rekindles the vibrant spirit of the '60s. Notes: Cedar, Tonka bean, Juniper berry, Jasmine

listings.rawTitle: Dirty Coconut Eau de Parfum Unisex 50 ml
listings.description: Creamy coconut flesh blends with sustainably harvested sandalwood in this sensual masterpiece that strays far from 'basic beach' scents and the saccharine tanning lotions of yesteryear to dive deep into an elevated blend of sunbathed exotic woods and warmed vanilla. A sophisticated take on coconut perfume, Dirty Coconut uses coconut CO2 to achieve a more authentic expression of the fruit and to showcase its intensely tropical notes. By blending it with pure organic coconut alcohol and an 'ungodly' amount of rich sandalwood, they merge into a seductively milky fragrance that's both lusty and renewing. Packed with natural aphrodisiacs and stress-relieving ingredients, Dirty Coconut conjures swaying palms in the tropics, seaside relaxation, and forbidden island trysts.Top Notes: Cedar, Vanillin (derived from clove)Heart Notes: Coconut CO2Heart Notes: Sandalwood, Vanilla Absolute, Ambrettolide

listings.rawTitle: Dirty Vanilla Eau de Parfum Unisex 15 ml
listings.description: Leave your more 'vanilla' expectations at the door. The inspiration for this sophisticated scent is Vanilla Planifolia, a rare orchid flower that opens for only one day a year with a hermaphroditic heart and both male and female organs nestled deep in the throat of the bloom. In keeping with the seductive allure of this complex creature, 100% natural Dirty Vanilla is our interpretation of the orchid herself: A rich, hypnotic fragrance teeming with natural, vine-grown Vanilla on a bed of warm, velvety Amber Musk.Top notes: Cedar, Coriander, Ho WoodHeart notes: VanillaBase notes: Patchouli, Sandalwood, Styrax, Vanillin, Vetiver
